title: Kit and the Red Hat
pages: Kit is a cat.
Kit has a red hat.
A big gust hits the hat.
The hat lands in the mud.
Kit is sad.
Pip can get the hat.
Kit and Pip sit. The hat is wet.
The hat will dry in the sun.

title: Pip and the Big Egg
pages: Pip has a big egg.
The egg is in the nest.
The wind hits the nest.
The egg tips to the rim.
Pip runs to the nest.
Kit can help Pip.
Kit and Pip fix the nest.
The egg is snug. Pip is glad.

title: Sam and the Fun Trip
pages: Sam has a red jet.
Kit and Pip can get in.
The jet is set to go.
Sam can lift the jet.
The jet is up in the sun.
Kit can spot a pond.
Sam lands the jet.
Kit and Pip grin. It is fun.
